info.title: EpiSim API
info.description: Epidemic scenario simulation for Rwanda (MVP demo). All outputs are scenario estimates, not forecasts.

post.description: Demo mode only: sign in as the seeded demo user for a role (the role switcher in the top bar).
Public: request an account. An administrator approves it and assigns the role (docs D11).

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Population Datasets Get

get.description: Datasets to choose from in the Scenario Builder (any role that builds scenarios).

schema.title: Response Dataset Options Api Population Datasets Options Get
Response Get Version Api Population Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions  Version  Get

get.description: Field specs for the column-mapping step, and the region codes the checks accept.

post.description: Checks every row of a CSV without importing it. Returns the same shapes as the import wizard.

schema.title: Response List Imports Api Population Imports Get

post.description: Imports a CSV as a new dataset, or as a new version of `datasetId`. Returns a job to poll.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api Disease Presets Get

post.description: Records that an epidemiologist reviewed the current values. Clearing 'provisional' is explicit.

schema.title: Response List Types Api Intervention Types Get
Response List Packages Api Intervention Packages Get
Response List Profiles Api Capacity Profiles Get

get.description:
Read-only list for analysis screens. Epidemiologists have no access to the Capacity module itself
(rbac.ts) but must pick a profile when analysing (docs D4/D7); see DECISIONS.

schema.title: Response Profile Options Api Capacity Profiles Options Get
Response Profile Comparisons Api Capacity Profiles  Profile Id  Comparisons Get
Response List Institutions Api Institutions Get

get.description: Scenarios the user may see. tab=mine (own) or tab=shared (shared with them); default both.

schema.title: Response List Scenarios Api Scenarios Get

put.description:
Drafts can change freely. A saved scenario keeps its inputs (runs refer to them): only name,
description, visibility and suggested capacity profile change; clone it to change the rest.

post.description:
Clone into an editable draft owned by the user. Needs owner, admin or 'clone' access.
Policy makers (scenarios: review) may clone scenarios shared with clone permission.

schema.title: Response Approved Scenarios Api Approved Scenarios Get

post.description: Queues a run and returns at once. Poll GET /api/simulations/{id} for status and progress.

get.description: The user's runs and runs on scenarios shared with them (policy makers: shared scenarios only).

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Simulations Get

get.description: Summary results with 5–95% ranges. Pass capacityProfileId to apply a capacity check.
Daily bands (5th, median, 95th) per series, columnar: {name: {low: [], median: [], high: []}}.

post.description: Preview (fewer runs): health-worker infections with different protection settings, same seed.

get.description: Rt (Cori et al.) estimated from the run's median daily incidence: what Rt tracking would show.

post.description:
"Start response on day X in district Y": re-runs the model with fewer Monte Carlo runs (a preview)
with and without the response, same seed, and returns before/after for that district.

schema.title: Response List Comparisons Api Scenario Comparisons Get

get.description: The 30 real district boundaries (GeoJSON) with code, name, province and label position (cx, cy).
Strongest estimated links between districts (the engine's gravity model, default parameters).

put.description: Importation risk per border country is a configurable assumption, not a calculation (docs Module 9).

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Rt Datasets Get

post.description: Import a CSV of daily counts with columns date, location, cases. No patient identifiers.
Adds one day's count (defaults to the day after the last record).

get.description: Daily Rt with a 95% interval. The serial interval comes from the disease's built-in preset.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api Reports Get

post.description: Create a draft. With simulationRunId and no figures, figures are filled from the run's results.
Send a pending report back to draft.
Pending approval → Approved. The approver must not be the author (docs D10).
Generates a PDF now (seconds) and records it. Only PDF in the MVP.

schema.title: Response List Exports Api Reports  Rid  Exports Get
Response List Reviews Api Intervention Reviews Get

put.description: Epidemiologists maintain the review; policy makers read it.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api Policy Alerts Get
Response List Entries Api Hospital Entries Get

post.description: One day of counts for one disease. Counts only — never patient details. Replaces that day's entry.

schema.title: Response List Instructions Api Hospital Instructions Get

post.description: Issue a response instruction to a hospital. Proposed for Epidemiologists (docs D9, open).

schema.title: Response List Plans Api Hospital Plans Get
Response List Users Api Admin Users Get
Response List Requests Api Admin Access Requests Get

post.description: Creates the account with the role the administrator assigns (docs D11).

schema.title: Response List Hospitals Api Admin Hospitals Get

get.description: Real checks: database, worker queue, run and import counts, disk. Nothing here is simulated.

schema.title: Response List Announcements Api Admin Announcements Get
Response List Tickets Api Admin Tickets Get
Response Published Announcements Api Announcements Get
